name: Gamayun eng→lin Evaluation Corpus
description: English→Lingala parallel evaluation corpus from CLEAR Global's Gamayun Parallel Sentence Kits. ~5,000 sentence pairs, humanitarian domain. Source sentences originate from Tatoeba but translations are unique, human-produced by CLEAR Global translators. Tail-split: last 2000 sentences held for test, remainder for dev.

recipe.note: last 2000 pairs = test split, remainder = dev split

license.notes: Bespoke TWB/CLEAR Global license (upstream LICENSE.txt), NOT plain CC-BY-4.0 as previously mistagged. Commercial use requires prior notice, derivatives must be released under an open license, and use is limited to humanitarian/mission purposes. Tagged conservatively (commercial=false, redistribution=false) and kept quarantined so it never enters a commercial or prize lane.

contamination.reasoning: Source sentences originate from Tatoeba (which is publicly crawlable), but the Lingala translations are unique human translations produced by CLEAR Global. The parallel pairs as a unit are unlikely to appear in LLM training data. Hosted on HuggingFace but as a niche humanitarian dataset.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Upstream uses a bespoke TWB/CLEAR Global license (LICENSE.txt), not plain CC-BY-4.0: commercial use requires prior notice, derivatives must stay open-licensed, and use is limited to humanitarian/mission purposes. _provenance.populatedFrom: CLEAR Global Gamayun Parallel Sentence Kits on HuggingFace (https://huggingface.co/datasets/CLEAR-Global/Gamayun-kits). Sentence count (~5,000) from dataset description. License from HuggingFace dataset card (CC-BY-4.0).

quarantineReason: gamayun-parallel builder not yet implemented; HF dataset layout unverified. Catalogued but not runnable.
